campaign: Report 16: He I edge moment closure
requirements: All 1/30/69/30 H-/HI/HeI/HeII levels, two-photon, Rayleigh, native rates, dissolution, radiation advection and relativistic terms retained in final candidates.
Fixed-J or fixed-T stages are initialization only. Final validation requires both released and independent population/rate, electron and radiation-energy checks.
Numerical damping or stencil changes must converge to the same equations under refinement; no fitted physical coefficients or production prescribed mdot.
Frozen failure operators and source-level derivative checks precede claiming native repairs.
Stop downstream work if no valid cool closure; no inference of physical nonexistence.
stages: Rate initialization with the bootstrap cool radiation field held fixed, MAX_LAM=10 numerical population-step limit; release radiation and T after populations settle.
Capture radiation-moment and variation failures with read-only native diagnostics. Compare operator and derivative consistency; test targeted numerical repair if evidence supports it.
Require final cool closure and quantitative internal mesh/frequency/response convergence before global mdot/sonic coupling.
Only after nonlocal material response and convective handoff gates, attach a physical envelope and attempt conservative selected wind/evolution.
primary_numerical_reference: Pinned CMFGEN full_descr.pdf sections 4.2/4.3 initialization and convergence; https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1365-2966.2012.21192.x
first_diagnostic: Read-only complete recurrence at the first negative raw moment solution in 5.9-6.0e15 Hz; no changes to physics/stencil; original checkpoints diagnostic only.
